verdict.rationale: Supabase provisions a managed Postgres database with auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, type-safe client SDKs (database.types.ts), and server-side access via CLI/self-hosting, backed by RLS for secure client-side queries. Core provisioning, CRUD from client SDKs, and server access are well documented and corroborated by community discussion of real-world usage. Missing for 10: deeper independent benchmarking of SDK reliability at scale and more first-hand hands-on developer confirmation beyond docs/community anecdotes.
